games.title: Justice Dance
games.description: Dance, rhythm, and partner-sync challenges in one music-focused workspace.
games.objective: Build timing, movement consistency, coordination, and replay similarity.

games.title: Flow Zone
games.description: A configurable zone game combining target grids, reactions, avoidance, and obstacle dodging.
games.objective: Move accurately and quickly while adapting to changing zone rules.

games.title: Mirror Match
games.description: Mirror your own movement, hold reference poses, or match a second recording.
games.objective: Improve pose control, bilateral symmetry, stability, and synchronization.

games.title: Balance Challenge
games.description: Center-control and freeze-pose drills calibrated to the participant.
games.objective: Reduce sway and maintain stable positions with controlled movement.

games.title: Path and Precision
games.description: Trace moving paths or switch to compact precision targets.
games.objective: Improve trajectory accuracy, smoothness, and controlled reach.

games.title: Sports Reaction
games.description: Reaction, reach, recovery, and obstacle challenges for sport-style movement.
games.objective: Train quick responses while returning to a controlled stance.

games.title: Rehabilitation Lab
games.description: Review controlled range-of-motion and stability tasks.

games.title: Ergonomics Lab
games.description: Review posture, bending, reaching, and repetitive movement quality.
games.objective: Identify safer and more consistent movement patterns.

games.title: Gait and Locomotion
games.description: Review walking symmetry, transitions, and movement stability.
games.objective: Compare stride consistency and balance over time.

games.title: Color Sequence
games.description: Visit highlighted zones in a changing sequence.
games.objective: Combine memory, reaction, and body control.
